# Careers Festival 2026

## Overview

Careers Festival 2026 operates on the principle that career readiness is an ongoing process rather than a fixed destination, one that can be actively shaped over time. Delivered by the Careers, Alumni & Industry Relations team, this event supports participants in developing capabilities aligned with their individual aspirations and competencies.

The festival pursues four main objectives:

Build career confidence — Learn to navigate today's job market, understand what employers expect, and take concrete action toward professional goals.

Explore employability opportunities — Connect with companies and discover various career pathways, internships, and job prospects.

Stand out as career-ready talent — Demonstrate your capabilities to employers actively recruiting qualified candidates.

Expand your professional network — Engage with organizations and establish connections supporting long-term career development.

Duration: 13 April - 13 May 2026
Locations: RMIT Vietnam (Saigon South and Hanoi campuses) plus online components
